verdict.rationale: Archived docs once described typed TypeScript SDKs generated for each published server and a Vercel AI SDK integration. Smithery's own shutdown notice says "The Smithery CLI and SDKs" stopped working on October 31, 2026, with those versions deprecated and the docs tree removed. Only the CLI continues under the acquirer's org, and a CLI is not an SDK, so there is no current official SDK to build against.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
